exposure: Newborn admission to intensive care unit
newborn admitted to an intensive care unit
cohort: 899 women who had given birth in the last 12 months in Spain
finding: Two out of three women reported experiencing obstetric violence during childbirth, with practices like skin-to-skin contact and respected birth plans being protective factors.
mod_finding: Women who required an urgent cesarean section had higher odds of experiencing obstetric violence.
